title: Aashiq
desc: Pooja and Chander fall in love and want to be together. However, since Pooja's alcoholic father would never approve, she decides to run away from her house but, unfortunately, lands in a brothel.

title: Mera Badla Revenge 2
desc: Satyajith seeks the help of a yogi when he is troubled by strange visions. He comes to know that the property he purchased a couple of years ago is haunted by a spirit.

title: Mumbai Ki Kiran Bedi
desc: When an IPS officer is killed by a criminal gang, her father meets her lookalike. He then decides to train her to be just like his daughter in order to avenge her death.

title: Maha Rakshak Devta 2
desc: When a sharp investigating officer based in Mumbai named Maddy goes to Kerala to look for a missing girl, he uncovers a dangerous sex trafficking scheme.

title: Hero The Bullet
desc: Shiva, a young man, is looked down upon by his father due to his irresponsible behaviour. He soon gets embroiled in a tussle with an egoistic gangster who threatens his family.
